author: Disney Parks YouTube
text:
FIRST LOOK: 2026 Halloween Food & Drinks Materialize at Disneyland Resort
Halloween Time at Disneyland Resort runs from Aug. 21 through Oct. 31, 2026🎃👻 

Halloween is creeping into Disneyland Resort... but can our panel guess what's on the menu?

Disney Legend Bob Gurr, creator and host Garrett Watts, and actress and Disney superfan Yvette Nicole Brown put their senses to the test as they try to identify brand-new 2026 Halloween food and beverages coming to Disneyland Resort. Using their taste, sight, smell, and sound, they'll have to uncover the mystery behind this Halloween season's newest treats before time runs out.

Need a little help? One ring of the bell summons a clue from the spirit world, courtesy of Madame Leota. 🔮

Will they guess every frightfully fun snack and delicious drink... or will Halloween's tastiest secrets remain hidden?
